Leknessund Wins Vuelta Stage Seven, Dedicates Victory

Andreas Leknessund won the seventh stage of the Vuelta a España cycling race. He broke away from the peloton to secure the victory. Leknessund dedicated his win to Norway's late king, Harald V. The stage was described as emotional.
